measures.title: Wayne County Malt Beverage Election
measures.summary: Asks Wayne County voters whether to permit the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages in the county.
measures.yesMeans: The on-premises and off-premises sale of malt beverages is permitted in Wayne County.
measures.noMeans: The on-premises and off-premises sale of malt beverages is not authorized by this election.

measures.title: Wayne County Unfortified Wine Election
measures.summary: Asks Wayne County voters whether to permit the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of unfortified wine in the county.
measures.yesMeans: The on-premises and off-premises sale of unfortified wine is permitted in Wayne County.
measures.noMeans: The on-premises and off-premises sale of unfortified wine is not authorized by this election.

measures.title: Wayne County Mixed Beverage Election
measures.summary: Asks Wayne County voters whether to permit the sale of mixed beverages in hotels, restaurants, private clubs, community theatres and convention centers, and the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages and unfortified wine in qualified establishments.
measures.yesMeans: Mixed beverage sales are permitted in qualified establishments in Wayne County.
measures.noMeans: Mixed beverage sales are not authorized by this election.
